grouped-balanced.name: Grouped by Regions (Optimized)
grouped-balanced.description: A more efficient version of 'Grouped by Regions (Classic)' that requires much less space. Organizes each generation together, placing alternate forms (that are unlikely to change) beside their species when that saves space. Regional forms stay with the generation where they were introduced, at the end of the box, making this a compact HOME Living Dex layout without separating every form into dedicated boxes. Gigantamax boxes are omitted.

grouped-region.name: Grouped by Regions (Classic)
grouped-region.description: Organizes each region with species first, then alternate forms in separate form boxes. Regional forms and Gigantamax-capable entries get their own sections, keeping the main regional species boxes stable when new forms are added.

fully-sorted.name: Fully Sorted by Regions
fully-sorted.description: Recommended when you want to sort species and forms together in National Pokédex order, with generation breaks and reserve space where useful. This is the most direct full-sort layout for a compact Living Dex that still makes future reorganization minimal thanks to the box breaks.

fully-sorted-minimal.name: Fully Sorted by Regions (Minimal)
fully-sorted-minimal.description: Same as 'Fully Sorted by Regions,' but Legendary and Mythical switchable forms are omitted.

species-first.name: Sorted species, then Form Groups
species-first.description: Organizes species boxes first without gaps, followed by form boxes grouped by generation and form category. Base forms are repeated in form sections when it makes sense visually, so related forms can be viewed together.

sorted-species.name: Species by Region, then sorted Forms
sorted-species.description: Sorts species in National Dex order, then starts a separate form section after the species boxes. Generation breaks keep the species section readable while forms remain separated from the main Living Dex sequence. Forms are fully sorted without breaks.

sorted-species-minimal.name: Species by Region, then sorted Forms (Minimal)
sorted-species-minimal.description: Same as 'Species by Region, then sorted Forms', but Legendary and Mythical switchable forms are omitted.
